summary: All 5 functional requirements trace directly to the design doc's UI section (lines 438-457) and Implementation Phase 7 (lines 706-711). No requirements were invented beyond the design doc's scope, and no design doc UI requirements were dropped. The Non-Goals section correctly excludes task/workflow-level cost UI and a standalone cost dashboard, neither of which the design doc's UI section calls for. FR-3 and FR-5 are appropriately flagged as judgment calls for architecture_design rather than force-resolved here, consistent with the design doc's own ambiguity (either DesignQueuePanel or PipelineStatusCard for the indicator; BudgetPausedLabel not explicitly named in the design doc's UI section). Verdict: PASS -- scope has not drifted.
